policy: This map records manually inspected source-to-test links. It does not upgrade feature-inventory.json statuses. Static assertions and unit tests are not Discord runtime or production verification. Entries without a current named behavioral test on main are deliberately omitted rather than linked to unrelated tests.

test.name: market purchases serialize the player before charging and never allow a negative balance

entries.limitation: Isolated PostgreSQL tests execute real concurrent purchase and forced rollback transactions. They do not invoke Discord's live interaction API or production data.

integrationTests.name: concurrent market purchases cannot overspend and inventory matches successful debits
market inventory failure rolls back the already attempted coin debit

test.name: trade offers are persistent, expiring and single-use

entries.limitation: Source assertions plus isolated PostgreSQL tests cover concurrent offer acceptance and rollback of both collections and offer status. Live Discord button delivery is not tested.

integrationTests.name: the same trade offer can be accepted concurrently only once
trade transfer failure rolls back both collection sides and offer status

test.name: solo boss reward persistence is idempotent per battle session across duplicate handlers

entries.limitation: Isolated PostgreSQL tests execute the production reward transaction under duplicate concurrency and forced inventory failure. Live Discord battle presentation remains unverified.

integrationTests.name: production solo boss reward transaction grants a battle only once under concurrency
production solo boss reward transaction rolls back player progression and all loot on inventory failure

test.name: legendary set bonus activates at two pieces and disappears when one is removed

entries.limitation: The unit test proves the shared set-bonus calculation and source wiring is present in combat handlers; it does not execute full solo, dungeon and raid encounters.

test.name: crafting validates bounded quantities and serializes the player before material locks
markers: crafting must lock the player before reading/locking materials
material consumption, output, crafting XP and daily progress must be one transaction

entries.limitation: The test checks lock ordering, quantity bounds and transaction structure; it does not perform a live Discord crafting action.

test.name: cooperative dungeon and raid scale current HP and mana proportionally with gear, talents, builds and roles

entries.limitation: The test validates shared persistence conversion and handler wiring through source assertions; it does not run a live multi-player encounter.

test.name: boss phases use stable health thresholds and reject invalid maximum HP

test.name: equipment equip and unequip are user-scoped transactions and never permanently add gear stats
markers: must not persist temporary max HP/mana bonuses

entries.limitation: Player-first row locking, user scoping, transactional equip/unequip and base-stat protection are statically asserted; no live Discord equip action is run.

markers: ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING mission_key

test.name: two concurrent daily mission claims grant the reward only once

entries.limitation: The isolated PostgreSQL test runs two real command handlers concurrently and checks the reward is credited once. It does not call Discord's live API.

test.name: concurrent trade offers cannot reserve the sender last character copy twice

entries.limitation: The isolated PostgreSQL test verifies concurrent offers cannot reserve the final copy twice. Player-visible Discord interaction delivery remains unverified.

test.name: production layered dungeon settlement is single-use for the whole party under concurrent completion

entries.limitation: The isolated PostgreSQL test verifies a full dungeon reward settlement writes party loot once and clears the encounter reservation. The complete Discord floor-by-floor battle is not run.

test.name: production co-op boss settlement is single-use for the whole party under concurrent completion

entries.limitation: The isolated PostgreSQL test verifies raid reward settlement is single-use and persists each participant's rewards atomically. Live Discord raid turns are not tested.

markers: ON CONFLICT(match_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING match_id

test.name: arena season MMR and rewards settle atomically and only once

entries.limitation: The isolated PostgreSQL test executes arena season settlement twice and confirms a single result/reward write. Discord match UI and live matchmaking are separately unverified.

markers: ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING user_id

test.name: event calendar enforces idempotent registration, capacity and concurrent seat claims

entries.limitation: The isolated PostgreSQL test verifies duplicate registration, capacity enforcement, leave/rejoin and concurrent seat claims. Automatic reminders and Discord UI delivery are not tested.

test.name: single-use Discord link codes connect only the intended profile to a web account

entries.limitation: The isolated PostgreSQL test verifies one-time token redemption and the linked dashboard data. The browser login/session journey and production account are not exercised.
